item.title: Music player v2.0.4
item.description: An update to my music player code, fixing several bugs, as well as bringing some formatting cleanup and other small improvements.

item.title: FLUX v2.0.0
item.description: A major overhaul for FLUX, bringing many new features to the music player, adding a Spanish translation, and deprecating several old functions.

item.title: 2025 development retrospective
item.description: A retrospective on my development activities in 2025, including things I released, things I updated, things I learned, etc.

item.title: Tuxeedle v1.0.2
item.description: A small update to Tuxeedle, adding a new ring color and dressup menu organization.

item.title: Birthday Needle v1.0.2
item.description: A small update to Birthday Needle, adding a new candle and some other minor adjustments.

item.title: Hydrate v2.0.5
item.description: A patch for Hydrate which fixes a few bugs and updates the readme information.

item.title: Left Unattended v1.1.0
item.description: The first separate release for Left Unattended, and a major update adding a lot of new content.

item.title: Writing word groups guide
item.description: The guide Writing word groups has been published. It is a guide about effective strategies for writing word groups, as well as various technical tips and tricks.

item.title: Ancient Gem set v1.0.1
item.description: An update to Ancient Gem, Ancient Gem Balloon, and Ancient Gem Calendar, completing all of the originally planned content and also fixing some minor issues.

item.title: Celestial Emblem v1.0.0
item.description: Release of a new balloon, Celestial Emblem, for Etc. Jam 2026.

item.title: Solar Runes v1.0.0
item.description: Release of a new freeshell, Solar Runes, for Etc. Jam 2026.

item.title: Upgrade Old Versions of YAYA guide update
item.description: A formatting update to the guide Upgrade Old Versions of YAYA, and a discussion of why that's important as well as a notice about an old YAYA bug that may persist in various ghosts.

item.title: Hoard of Shinies v1.0.7
item.description: A minor update to Hoard of Shinies for its birthday, which adds a small amount of new content.

item.title: Update to Notepad++ tips to improve your ghost dev experience
item.description: A small update to the guide Notepad++ tips to improve your ghost dev experience, adjusting the description of column editing and adding more details about multi-editing.

item.title: Sweet Dreams v1.0.0
item.description: Release of a new ghost: Sweet Dreams. An entry for Ghost Masquerade 8, this ghost explores themes of protection and safety, while also offering non-judgemental sleep advice.

item.title: Guide: How to get X and Y coordinates quickly without changing programs
item.description: A new guide, How to get X and Y coordinates quickly without changing programs, has been released on the Ukagaka Dream Team Forum. The guide is made for balloon and shell developers who don't have a coordinates display in their drawing program of choice.

item.title: Hydrate v2.0.6
item.description: A minor update to Hydrate, readding the shell scaling values to the OnHydrateStatsNotify event now that it's possible to track them more closely.

item.title: Don't Hold Your Breath v1.0.0
item.description: Release of a new ghost: Don't Hold Your Breath, a short horror ghost made for Ghost Masquerade 8.

item.title: Hoard of Shinies v1.0.8
item.description: The ghost Hoard of Shinies has been updated to v1.0.8! This update adds new dialogues.

item.title: Flakes of Fancy v1.0.0
item.description: The ghost Flakes of Fancy has been released! Bring winter to your desktop in the middle of summer!

item.title: Pixel Flakes v1.0.0
item.description: The shell Pixel flakes has been released, to make your desktop winter a little crunchier!

item.title: Thoughtful Replies v1.0.0
item.description: The ghost Thoughtful Replies has been released! In the quietest hours of the night, a certain homebody writes heartfelt notes by candlelight.

item.title: Chicken Scratch v1.0.0
item.description: The balloon Chicken Scratch has been released, for all your chicken-and-stationery needs!

item.title: Aughost 2026 announcement
item.description: Aughost 2026 will be starting soon! See the event's page for the guidelines.

item.title: ATM Machine v2.0.3
item.description: A minor update to ATM Machine has been released, bringing some tidying and a bugfix.
